title: HTTP /design/read serves the versioned aggregate to the operator
description:
SPIDR child of task-8a6d6660c31c4e119f962d13e6f1505d, spun from task-f3409f9a1f3a4925a73974ea371098e5 (architect-2e480458, 2026-09-05) because child 3's DoD requires POST `/design/read` and that route does not exist.

OBJECTIVE: the operator (and the later Design tab) can POST `/design/read` against a real daemon and get the versioned design aggregate child 1 already stores.

DELIVERABLE: handleDesignReadRequest at `/design/read`, composed as an optional listener port the same way document-dossier-read is, calling readDesignRevision. JSON_ROUTES + POST guard + dispatch. Exact-key body `{goalRef}` or `{goalRef, version}`; projectId from the principal.

NOT IN SCOPE: MCP (task-7f9f20c7), design.submit roster (task-06ac0da1), Design tab / live decoder / proxy pin (sibling UI row), approval card, e2e.

MEASURED: grep handleDesign|/design/read in apps/daemon/src = 0. Child 1 landed readDesignRevision (design-store.ts:189). 06ac0da1 publishes MCP command/query, not HTTP. document-dossier-read.ts is the copy shape.

VERIFICATION: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` plus `pnpm typecheck`.
definitionOfDone: POST `/design/read` is a JSON_ROUTES member with a POST-only guard and a dispatch branch. An unconfigured daemon (no design port) refuses LISTENER_DESIGN_UNAVAILABLE (or the existing UNAVAILABLE pattern for optional reads) with a stable code AND layer, and writes nothing.

The handler authenticates first, then exact-key decodes the body as `{goalRef}` or `{goalRef, version}`. Extra key, missing goalRef, non-string goalRef, or payload-supplied projectId is REFUSED at the listener with a stable code AND layer. projectId is taken from the authenticated principal.

A well-formed operator read of a stored revision returns the record plus the versions list from readDesignRevision. DESIGN_REVISION_ABSENT is forwarded with code AND layer. Assert both against a real file-backed store.

UNCONSUMED_SERVED_ROUTES in http-listener-read-dispatch.test.ts names `/design/read` with a reason (no browser consumer yet). UNPROXIED_SERVED_PATHS stays empty only if the proxy pin lands in the same commit; otherwise `/design/read` is recorded there. Do not leave a silent gap.
Gates quoted WITH `Test Files N passed`: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`. A leg with no count line RAN NOTHING.
taskRails: Call readDesignRevision from apps/daemon/src/design/design-store.ts. Do not reimplement the aggregate.
projectId comes from the authenticated principal, never the payload. A payload that carries projectId is an unknown key and is REFUSED.
http-listener-read-dispatch.ts is already 539 lines (over 400). Add the route; do not reformat or split the file in this row.
FEATURES ONLY. No MCP work (that is task-7f9f20c7). No UI (that is the Design-tab sibling).

(b) Confirm the gap: grep DESIGN_READ_PATH|/design/read in apps/daemon/src/http is empty. (c) Read goal-source-read.ts and goal-source-read.test.ts end to end — that is the copy shape (auth, GOAL capability, optional port, exact-key body, listener vs port refusal split). (e) `git status --porcelain -- apps/daemon/src/http/` — peer dirt is context, never a stop. Put measured line counts (dispatch, guards) in the step note.

HANDLER MODULE. New apps/daemon/src/http/design-read.ts plus `export * from "./design-read.ts";` bridge design-read.js (a missing bridge is ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at boot).

Copy goal-source-read.ts:
- DESIGN_READ_PATH = `/design/read`
- DesignReadPort `{ read(input: { goalRef: string; version?: number }): DesignReadResult }` — the handler supplies principal.projectId when calling readDesignRevision; the port closes over store+projectId in the composition sibling. For THIS row's tests, the injected port may close over a store itself.
- authenticateHttpRequest from http-command-ingress.js first.
- GOAL capability check.
- Missing port -> LISTENER_DESIGN_UNAVAILABLE.
- Exact-key body: own enumerable keys are exactly `["goalRef"]` or `["goalRef","version"]`. goalRef non-empty string. version, if present, a finite number. Any other key including projectId -> LISTENER_DESIGN_REQUEST_INVALID.
- On success reply 200 with the DesignReadResult (ok record+versions, or DesignRefusal forwarded verbatim with its code AND layer). Do not wrap store refusals as listener codes.
- Stay under 250 lines.

http-listener-guards.ts (already 404 lines): add LISTENER_DESIGN_REQUEST_INVALID and LISTENER_DESIGN_UNAVAILABLE next to the GOAL_SOURCE pair; statusFor 400 and 503 next to the GOAL_SOURCE mappings. Do not reformat the rest of the file.

MUTATION DRILL, GATES, ADVERSARIAL (skill adversarial-self-review).

Before mutating: `git status --porcelain` on the exact paths. Tracked files restore with empty git diff; new files restore by SHA256 vs %TEMP% backup (rail 13), hash in a call SEPARATE from the restore.

(a) Remove `/design/read` from JSON_ROUTES only -> dispatch-seam set-equality reds.
(b) Remove LISTENER_DESIGN_UNAVAILABLE from LISTENER_REFUSAL_CODES only -> typecheck or the unconfigured arm reds.
(c) Delete the extra-key refusal in the handler only -> extra-key arm goes green (that is the red you want). Restore each.

GATES standalone foreground: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` (this IS complete_task verification), `pnpm typecheck`. Quote Test Files N passed. Path-attributed baseline for foreign red.

Adversarial: payload projectId cannot cross projects; version 1 remains after version 2; unconfigured port writes nothing; else-chain still ends at dossier; composition files untouched. Report every path in complete_step.modifiedFiles including the .js bridge.

Named verification command: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: 1) Land HTTP handler, JSON_ROUTES, listener options, store composition, FACTORIES, providerKeys, and daemon-entry spread in one row. Rejected: that is 11+ files vs the 10-file hard cap (dispatch 539 lines, guards 404, plus foundation-composition and daemon-entry). Composition is task-eb2bb09d. 2) Skip ListenerRefusalCode and let refuseRequest take a string. Rejected: refuseRequest is typed on LISTENER_REFUSAL_CODES; an unrostered code does not typecheck. 3) Return DesignRefusal through refuseRequest. Rejected: store refusals have LEDGER/REQUEST layers; listener refusals are CONTROL_ROOM_LISTENER. Forward store answers as a 200 body like goal-source-read; listener invalid/unavailable stay refuseRequest. 4) Empty body like document-dossier. Rejected: design is per-goal; DesignReadInput requires goalRef. Copy goal-source-read's `{goalRef}` exact body, widened to also admit `{goalRef, version}`.
